facts.fact: CIPIT's 2025 continental report states that Egypt has deployed AI-driven electronic health record systems, using large biomedical language models to assist record-keeping, diagnostics and treatment planning in public hospitals, citing an arXiv paper; it gives no count of hospitals, does not distinguish the hospital tier and gives no date, so the document's published date is used.

note: One sentence on Egypt in a continental report; the source it cites is an arXiv paper on a proposed system, so the parent may wish to weigh the claim of deployment.
